controls: actual incumbent with features frozen at round lock

comparators: actual incumbent with features frozen at round lock

role_calibration.formula: prediction + clip(sum(prior actual-minus-prediction residuals in position/status group)/(n+20), -5, 5)
role_calibration.window: all available earlier official slates in the same competition; no current slate; Six Nations 2026 can use 2025
role_calibration.fallback: zero correction when no prior observations

kicking_role_gate.formula: Scale means of conversions, missed conversions, penalties and missed penalties by 220/(220+exposure) only when complete observed goal-stat history has no attempts. Any observed attempt or no complete history leaves means unchanged.
kicking_role_gate.exposure: strict prior match history; positive available minutes; all four goal statistics available and finite; 420-day decay; club confidence 0.55; international confidence 1.0
kicking_role_gate.distribution: Preserve negative-binomial shape; no redistribution and no change to minutes or other events.
kicking_role_gate.recovery: Issue21 supplied formula; named package and patch were absent from repository and indexed local files. This is a newly implemented formula, not a replay of the unavailable source package.

regularised_combination.formula: Let d=robust-comparator and r=actual-comparator on prior known rows. w=clip((sum(d*r)+0.5*60*mean(d*d))/(sum(d*d)+60*mean(d*d)),0,1). Predict comparator+w*d. Use w=0.5 if denominator is zero or no earlier data exist.
regularised_combination.window: same prior-only competition window as role calibration
comparators: actual incumbent with features frozen at round lock
regularised_combination.selection: unchanged common optimiser; no weight tuning on later audit

bench_entry_branch.first_step: Audit zero-minute availability and historical bench entry support. The existing robust minutes head already includes observed zero-minute appearances. Do not apply a second entry multiplier without evidence that the underlying event forecast is conditional on entry.
bench_entry_branch.reason: A separate improved minutes marginal leaves event means and expected points unchanged. Blind rescaling was rejected in Issue21.

admission: Use the protocol advancement criteria. Retain every result. Historical research priority only; no prospective superiority claim.
